name: NetSupport RAT check-in over plaintext HTTP on port 443
description: Real capture from a malware-traffic-analysis.net traffic-analysis exercise, replayed through Suricata with the ET Open ruleset. The victim posts to a bare IPv4 address on port 443 in cleartext HTTP, identifying itself with the NetSupport Manager user agent.
